evaluation.boundary_metric_endpoint_note: Source reporting command uses periodic acquisition endpoints and the separate heldout final endpoint; these cohorts are preserved, not silently relabelled as the same evaluator draws.

headline.summary: Completed six-task seed-0 D pilot, held-out final raw returns: MsPacman 4906.25; Boxing 92.8125; CrazyClimber 97766.7; Frostbite 2895; Seaquest 907.5; Enduro 225.6.

comparability.claim: Single-seed, task-aware D pilot; not an official reproduction or an evaluator-matched ranking against StableTargets/ARROW.
limitations: Task identity selects the model route and private policy.
Deterministic fixed/heldout evaluation differs from the stochastic advancing-cohort StableTargets record.
552,000 WM updates include 12,000 consolidation/recovery updates; equal replay sample capacity does not match dtype, bytes or compute.
Final rollout count is the historical nominal trajectory evaluator, not the new exact-complete-episode AutoRoute evaluator.
Forward transfer is unavailable without aligned single-task curves.

notes: Remote metadata, final evaluation and full-log hashes match the previously downloaded local archive.
This is D with adaptive Q/F/P and shared prediction heads, not the retired dense Evolving-Core v2 partial pilot.
Periodic evaluations of future tasks remain isolated measurements, not training labels or successful task acquisition.
Weights, Replay, full logs and optimizer states remain outside Git.
